outcome: adverse pregnancy outcomes (prematurity, premature rupture of membranes, chorioamnionitis)
cohort: 6892 pregnant women screened for GBS and 48 GBS-positive newborns.
finding: While GBS colonization in pregnant women was not independently associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes after adjusting for other risk factors, GBS was more likely to affect premature, low-weight newborns with poor health status.
